stories.title: LINK to carry out new assessment of Holywell banking needs after town lost its last bank
stories.summary: LINK, which runs the UK’s cash machine network, will carry out a new assessment of Holywell’s banking needs after the town lost its last bank. stories.title: Flintshire railway stations have busiest year on record, ORR figures show
stories.summary: Flintshire’s railway stations were used more than ever last year, with almost 943,000 entries and exits across the county’s nine stations. Figures from the Office of Rail and Road (ORR), published today (Thursday, 19 November), show use rose at every station in Flintshire between April 2025 and March 2026. stories.title: Six sheep die after being chased by dog on Cilcain Mountain
stories.summary: Six sheep have died on Cilcain Mountain after being chased and cornered by a dog, North Wales Police has said. stories.title: Power cut hits part of Mancot and Aston with supply due back by 2pm
stories.summary: Update, 13:30 19 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Mancot and Aston is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 2pm. stories.title: Land the size of 26 football pitches can now be bought for new A494 bridge at Queensferry
stories.summary: Land the size of about 26 football pitches in Queensferry, Sealand and Holywell can now be bought by the Welsh Government for the new A494 River Dee bridge, whether the owners want to sell or not.
